visualCharacteristics.purpose: centered feature items with a round icon badge, heading and descriptive text
visualCharacteristics.summary: Centered items with a round icon badge above an h3 and descriptive text, with no card chrome.

contentPattern.structure: one cell: an :icon: token (tu-contenido, tramites, comparte, opina), an h3 and a paragraph with links
contentPattern.notes: Repeating look-alike items (icon, title, text). The icons are icon-font glyphs, so this uses the no-images card model.

usage: Short value propositions or service features with an icon, title and text. Swipe carousel on mobile.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for icon + heading + text items without photos. Use cards-topics for link-only tiles.
